title: Error Count
story:
The black box's `log.txt` is thousands of lines of chatter. Mission control only wants the totals.

The judge puts `log.txt` next to your program. Every line starts with a level, `INFO`, `WARN` or `ERROR`, then a space and a message (lines are under 200 characters).

Output: three lines, `INFO a`, `WARN b`, `ERROR c`, with the count of each.

WARN fan slow
ERROR disk

ERROR disk again

hints: Read the file a line at a time with `fgets(line, sizeof line, f)` in a while loop. A buffer of 256 chars fits every line.
`strncmp(line, "ERROR ", 6) == 0` checks the start of the line, so ERROR **inside** a message doesn't count.
Keep three counters, then print them in the order INFO, WARN, ERROR. An empty file prints all zeros.
